name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. The '0c' is a domain ID = index 0x0C of the per-event handler dispatch table at 0x51B91 (valid table-index range 0x00..0x2E), NOT a Ghidra address residue (the function's own address is 0x34594, unrelated to 0x0C). The '__unref_first_time' descriptor accurately captures both observed properties: the slot is unreferenced by any chapter FDFIELD turn-event/tile-step hook (0 direct callers; only DATA xref is the table slot at 0x51BC1), and the body is first-time-gated (runs once, then consumes tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10]). No address residue anywhere in the name.
purpose: Unreferenced first-time-gated chapter event handler (dispatch table slot 0x0C): on its first invocation it arms AI control flag 7 on four enemy runtime-char slots (chars 0x18..0x1B) and shows dialog page 3, then consumes its trigger so every later call is a no-op.
logic_summary: Gate: if tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] (byte at *data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr + 0x10) == 0, then (1) fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x18, 0x1B, 7) -- writes low nibble 7 into combat_aux_block[0xD] (absolute runtime_char offset 0x34, the per-event AI/dialog control flag) for the inclusive char range 0x18..0x1B (4 chars); (2) fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=3, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) with the fixed dialog geometry shared across this file's handlers; (3) set tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] = 1 to consume the trigger. Straight-line single-branch body; no RNG, no numeric computation, and no CALL return value used. __CHK(0x28) is the compiler-injected stack-probe prologue; EBX is not touched (disasm has no PUSH/POP EBX).

params.semantics: The uniform 1-arg cdecl argument supplied by the per-event handler dispatch table at 0x51B91. The body never reads it (declared (void)event_arg in src). Matches the live Ghidra name.
params.reason: Name reflects its role as the dispatch-table event argument; the table is uniform 1-arg cdecl and this handler ignores the value. No address residue, no placeholder; identical in src and Ghidra.

returns.semantics: No return value. Visible side effects (only on first call): AI flag 7 armed on chars 0x18..0x1B, dialog page 3 shown, and the consume byte tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] set to 1.
